findings.message: 1 headline(s) wrap past two lines at 1440px: "Learn from a qualified beauty lecturer" → 4 lines (6 words, 72px)
findings.fix:
Cut words first (a headline is a title, not a sentence). Then give it a wider measure. Lower the size only as a last resort and never below the scale you chose. A real statement paragraph belongs in a

or

at 36px or less.

findings.message: 5 eyebrow/kicker label(s) above headings: "What we do" above "Treatments"; "Visit" above "Pop in or call"; "Appointments" above "Book your appointment"; "Step 1 of 3" above "Choose a treatment"; "Call to book" above "01509 215678"
findings.fix: Delete them. If the label carried real information, fold it into the headline or the supporting sentence.
Remove them. If order truly matters, write it into the words ("First, …") or use a real <ol>.

findings.message: 11 tiny uppercase letter-spaced labels (e.g. "What we do", "Training Academy", "Years inthe industry", "Visit").
findings.fix: Use sentence-case text at a readable size, or delete the label.

findings.message: 2 gradient fill(s): section#top.hero → radial-gradient(130% 75% at 50% -5%, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15) 0%, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0) 62%), radial-gradien | div.ph → repeating-linear-gradient(135deg, rgb(238, 240, 244) 0px, rgb(238, 240, 244) 12px, rgb(232, 235, 240) 12px, rg
findings.fix: Use a flat colour or a real image. The only gradient allowed by default is a neutral scrim over a photo for legibility.

findings.message: 2 box-shadow(s) on elements at rest: a.btn.btn-white → rgba(16, 20, 28, 0.45) 0px 14px 34px -12px | div#book-card.book-card → rgba(10, 14, 22, 0.6) 0px 40px 90px -30px
findings.fix: Remove. Separate surfaces with a tone step or space. Shadows are for things that really float (menus, dialogs, sticky bars).

findings.message: 21 thin rule(s)/divider line(s): a.menu-item 1144px | a.menu-item 1144px | a.menu-item 1144px | a.menu-item 1144px
findings.fix: Delete. Separate with space, a tone change, or scale. Lines are only for real tables and form fields.
Prefer a filled surface or no box.
One blurred sticky bar at most; glass cards are a tell.
A page needs about five: display, heading, lead, body, small.

findings.message: No video anywhere on the page.
findings.fix: Look for one honest clip with scripts/assets.mjs --video (the place, the material, the process) and use it as a muted loop with a poster frame. Defend its absence only if no clip fits the subject.
Nothing meant to be read goes below 13px.

findings.message: A section keeps its content on one side and leaves 792px of the width empty: section#visit.visit.
findings.fix: Fill the other side with what the section has (its picture, a second column, the figure), or defend the void in one sentence.

findings.message: Large text lies under another element at some scroll position: "Treatments" (screen 6, 100% hidden); "Academy" (screen 6, 100% hidden); "Visit" (screen 6, 100% hidden); "Book" (screen 6, 100% hidden)
findings.fix: Nothing may sit on top of a headline or statement. Move the picture, shorten the pinned run, or raise the text above it (z-index) and give it a ground.

findings.message: Pinned large text slides across pictures while the page scrolls: "Treatments" (screen 5, 100% over a picture); "Academy" (screen 4, 100% over a picture); "Visit" (screen 4, 100% over a picture)
findings.fix: Jurors read a pinned title crossing drawings or photographs as a collision. Keep the pictures in the column the title does not occupy, or unpin it.
